summary: Single-thumb range input with a built-in label, supporting text and error text; use to pick one number from a continuous or stepped range.

usage.text: The value is clamped to min..max and snapped to step from min whenever any of them changes, so read it back after setting it. Without a value attribute it starts at 50, clamped into range.
There is no empty state: the form always receives the current value, and form reset restores the value it had when it connected.
The required attribute has no effect on validity. Only invalid makes it invalid, and the error text (default "Please choose a valid value.") is shown only while invalid is set.
Each arrow-key step fires both input and change. A pointer drag fires input while moving and one change on release.
The show-ticks attribute draws marks only when the range divides into 2 to 50 steps.

a11y.text: The value-text attribute becomes aria-valuetext. Set it when the number alone is not meaningful, for example "Medium", and update it as the value changes.
The error text, shown while invalid, is linked to the input as its description after the supporting text.
